body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Graceful unicorn optimist; appreciation of elegant supported ideas, warm clear correction, no constant sparkle references. Voice direction: Clear female soprano with a subtle French accent and silvery resonance. Graceful flowing phrasing and light genuine delight. Radiant and composed, not breathy babyish sweetness. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: That is a lovely connection. One piece supports another, keeping the position together. Before it moves, notice what will lose that support.
